lines: Best placement of the ≥ 1″ area: REFS AVRG (ETS 0.36).
Closest on the peak: HRRR, 4.10″ vs 10.21″ observed at its resolution (40%).
Far too dry overall (under half the observed rain volume): ECMWF IFS 2%, ECMWF AIFS 2%, ECMWF ENS mean 3%, ECMWF ENS P75 4%.
Earliest signal: GEFS max reached half the observed peak 72 h before the window started.
summary.method: Score = mean of placement (ETS at the event threshold ÷ 0.5, capped at 1), peak (e^-|ln ratio| of forecast to observed near-max at the model's resolution) and volume (e^-|ln bias|), each from the model's shortest-lead run.
